item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena stands 3 m in front of a large plane mirror in her school corridor and sees her image in it. She then walks towards the mirror until she is 1 m away from it.
How does the apparent distance of her image behind the mirror change?

options.A: It increases from 3 m to 5 m behind the mirror.
options.B: It decreases from 3 m to 1 m behind the mirror.
options.C: It stays at 3 m behind the mirror because the mirror does not move.
options.D: It becomes zero because the image always lies on the mirror surface.
